diagram_math_checks.objects: Rate vectors (R_1,R_2) in nonnegative real rate plane; axes measured in nats per source symbol, not morphisms.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Supplier thm-it-slepian-wolf-rate-region Statement gives nonempty-subset entropy inequalities with natural logarithms. Example Verification 1.1 gives H(X|Y)=H(Y|X)=h(p), and 2.1 gives H(X,Y)=ln2+h(p). Hence the three displayed constraints are exactly R_1>=h(p), R_2>=h(p), R_1+R_2>=ln2+h(p).

diagram_math_checks.objects: Left panel boundary vertices A=(h(p),ln2), B=(ln2,h(p)); segment A--B plus upward ray at A and rightward ray at B.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 3.1 establishes 0<=h(p)<=ln2 and the active sum constraint on h(p)<=R_1<=ln2. Both vertices satisfy equality in the sum bound. For R_1>=ln2 the active boundary is R_2=h(p); for R_2>=ln2 the symmetric coordinate boundary is R_1=h(p). Shading is precisely the intersection of these three half-planes within the pictured viewport. Its apparent top/right limits are truncation, with ray arrows showing continuation. Left-panel relative positions are schematic for 0<p<1/2; source entropy formula and strict KL equality show 0<h(p)<ln2 there.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Right panel p=1/2 and caption p=0 limits.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Substitution in h(p) gives h(1/2)=ln2, so A=B=(ln2,ln2); coordinate bounds then imply the sum bound R_1+R_2>=2ln2. The two positive-direction rays bound exactly that orthant. At p=0 the zero-term convention gives h(0)=0 and the caption correctly lists (0,ln2),(ln2,0). No common-information quantity is depicted or inferred.
